usage: wiki.py [-h] {help,ingest,search,ask,chat,status} ...

Celeste: a local Gemma assistant and source-grounded Uruguay 2010 wiki. No
cloud fallback.

positional arguments:
  {help,ingest,search,ask,chat,status}
    help                Show available commands
    ingest              Index original sources and generate linked wiki notes
                        with local Gemma
    search              Show original passages and paths; does not call the
                        model
    ask                 Answer a standalone factual question with checked
                        source citations
    chat                Conversational assistant with recent context and
                        optional source retrieval
    status              Show exact model, runtime and configuration

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
